title: The Paid Agent Company Achieves Major Growth Milestones, Establishes Itself as Go-To Partner for Agents Seeking Qualified Seller Appointments | User | mammothtimes.com
text:
Green Bay, WI - April 9, 2025 - The Paid Agent Company, a rapidly emerging player in the real estate technology and services space, is pleased to announce a record-setting momentum as it continues to disrupt the traditional lead generation model for real estate professionals. Following a 243% quarter-over-quarter growth rate and national expansion into 36 US states, the company has officially crossed the milestone of over 3500 pre-qualified seller appointments delivered to agents, teams, and brokerages. These series of wins continue to strengthen The Paid Agent Company’s position as a trusted partner for real estate businesses in need of consistent, high-quality seller appointments.
Founded by 18-year-old entrepreneur and visionary Brayden Benz, The Paid Agent Company offers a new approach to how agents connect with motivated sellers in today’s hyper-competitive market. They leverage rigorous quality control and human-to-human conversations to help agents significantly scale their listing pipelines – double or triple their previous appointment volume.
“Our rapid expansion reflects what real estate professionals need right now – qualified seller opportunities that convert,” said Benz. “Top agents know that quality conversations lead to contracts, but most don’t have the time, training, or infrastructure to consistently generate those conversations. We’ve built a system that delivers results at scale so our clients can stay focused on closing deals.”
The company builds a high-performance cold-calling sales team tailored to each client’s unique market and goals. These trained professionals handle the time-consuming task of turning cold contacts into warm listing appointments. They reach out to FSBOs, expired listings, absentee owners, and long-term homeowners, creating real conversations that move the needle.
Each appointment is pre-screened using four key criteria:
Seller intends to list within six months
Property is not under contract with another agent
Genuine motivation to sell
Willingness to speak with a licensed professional
This rigorous qualification process, including manual double-verification by the company’s internal quality control team, has led to 70%+ appointment show-up rates. Clients also report conversion rates of up to 40% from appointment to signed listing.
“Agents need more than just data. They need conversations that lead to closings. This is the problem we solve every day,” adds Benz.
As the company continues its nationwide expansion, it remains focused on providing value, transparency, and performance for every real estate partner it serves.
Please visit https://thepaidagent.com/ to learn more about The Paid Agent Company or to schedule a call with Brayden Benz.
